[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on how to make the most of their morning commute.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering listening to audiobooks or podcasts during their commute.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Audiobooks can immerse the user in a story or help them learn something new.
